name: io.github.cyanheads/crossref-mcp-server
description: Resolve DOIs, search ~155M scholarly works, and fetch references via the Crossref REST API.

environmentVariables.name: CROSSREF_MAILTO
environmentVariables.description: Email for polite-pool User-Agent header — optional. Without: anonymous pool with stricter rate limits.

environmentVariables.name: CROSSREF_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Crossref API base URL. Defaults to https://api.crossref.org.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
